name: Documents: Climate Litigation Database export
task: The documents: filings, pages, extracted text. Every citation comes from here.
source: Sabin Center for Climate Change Law (Columbia Law School) with Climate Policy Radar; use authorised by Maria Antonia Tigre (Sabin Center)
note: 16,791 filings, 569,218 indexed pages. Text extracted with OCR where needed.

name: Name search, first version
task: Finds the citations (the name of the case in all its forms) and extracts page and passage.
status: superseded by V10 for the rows that name the case
note: Name forms are in the case files. Two defects, corrected in V10: the semantic filters (reranker threshold, decision date) also applied to rows that name the case and were found by both networks; long references were split into two rows.

name: Name search, corrected
task: Finds the citations that name the case. No semantic filter on rows that name the case; an identifier (docket number, ECLI, web address) close to the previous match continues the same citation; Korean and Japanese forms of Urgenda.

measures.name: rows merged (one citation split in two rows)
rows already judged, found again by the new search

note: Rows merged as parts of a split citation are kept, marked with the row they were merged into. Added rows do not yet carry machine readings.
what_changes: no semantic filter on rows that name the case; a long reference stays one citation; Korean and Japanese forms of Urgenda

name: Citation reading, first version
task: As L02, without the rule on footnotes. Two readings per row, on every citation of Urgenda.
status: replaced by L02 (its readings are kept in the archive)
hardware: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (ReCaS-Bari data centre, INFN and University of Bari)
note: Replaced because the model and the coders disagreed mostly in footnotes (agreement 0.32 in footnotes against 0.60 in the body).

name: Paragraph map
task: Principle taken by a citation that names a paragraph (e.g. «para. 5.7.7»): no model involved; usable as a training label.

measures.name: citations with a principle from the paragraph map

note: Paragraph numbers of up to three digits; the window after a mention stops at a semicolon.

name: Citation reading, Urgenda
task: For each citation: is it really the case? type of citation, speaker, proposition, reason. Two readings per row.
hardware: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (ReCaS-Bari data centre, INFN and University of Bari)

measures.name: agreement with human coders on type (Urgenda, 317 rows, first reading)

note: Includes the codebook rule on footnotes.
what_changes: same model and settings; the instructions add the rule on footnotes

name: Citation reading, Neubauer and Future Generations
task: Same as V02, generalised to other cases: the name may also be a person or party carrying it.
hardware: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (ReCaS-Bari data centre, INFN and University of Bari)
note: Applies to Neubauer and Future Generations.
what_changes: same instructions, generalised to other cases: the name may be a person or a party

name: Uptake reading
task: Which principles the citation takes, and which nearby pages continue the argument, with a supporting sentence and a comment.
status: in use where V05 is not available
hardware: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (ReCaS-Bari data centre, INFN and University of Bari)
note: Instructions reconstructed from the V05 file by removing its two additions (footnote rule, verbatim quotation). Supporting sentences were verbatim in 53-64% of cases.

name: Uptake reading with the case dossier
task: As V04, with the case dossier and two rules: a sentence carrying a footnote to another source does not continue the uptake; the supporting sentence must be copied verbatim; the filing sentence that the citation supports is quoted.
status: queued: rows to judge will receive it when the model runs
hardware: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (ReCaS-Bari data centre, INFN and University of Bari)
note: Motivated by a continuation proposed across a footnote that cites another case.
what_changes: same model; the instructions add the case dossier, the footnote rule, verbatim quotation and the supported sentence; nearby pages up to ten pages away

name: TRACE-Reranker 0.1
task: Scores a principle against a text (citation passage, nearby pages): proposes principles and nearby pages to read.

training.data: 263 team judgments on semantic rows of Urgenda (frozen split)
training.settings: LoRA rank 16 on q,k,v,o; 2 epochs; three seeds averaged; «uptake» instruction; 2,560 tokens

hardware: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (ReCaS-Bari data centre, INFN and University of Bari)

measures.name: top-scored principle among those of the paragraph map (Urgenda, 526 citations)

note: Trained on labels that mixed argument and source: to be retrained on confirmed principles.
family: TRACE model trained by the project

name: Rules that put the proposals together
task: Combines V01, V02-V05 and V06 into the proposals shown to coders, with the codebook rules.
rules: ticked principles: those from the paragraph map (V01) and from the reading (V04/V05); the reranker (V06) is a hint and never ticks
chain mention: principle «none»; hints remain visible
no continuation page is ticked when the citation takes no principle
the sentence under a nearby page is shown as a quotation only if it is verbatim in the page; otherwise it is labelled as a machine summary
note: Writes only to rows without a human judgment.

name: TRACE-Reader v0
task: The reader task on a single GPU: type, speaker, proposition, reason.

training.data: 1,120 DeepSeek readings (V02, V04) of Urgenda citations with two agreeing readings on type; all test rows excluded
training.settings: LoRA rank 16 on attention and MLP; 2 epochs; lr 1e-4; gradient accumulation 8; 6,144 tokens

hardware: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (ReCaS-Bari data centre, INFN and University of Bari)
family: TRACE model trained by the project

name: TRACE-Reader v1
task: The reader task on a single GPU: type, speaker, proposition, reason, principles and nearby pages.

training.data: 1,120 DeepSeek readings (V02, V04) of Urgenda citations with two agreeing readings on type; all test rows excluded
training.settings: LoRA rank 16 on attention and MLP; 2 epochs; lr 1e-4; gradient accumulation 8; 8,192 tokens

hardware: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (ReCaS-Bari data centre, INFN and University of Bari)

measures.name: agreement with human coders
measures.value: type 0.599; principles: at least one correct 0.79 on 101 rows with a paragraph (DeepSeek 0.86)

family: TRACE model trained by the project
what_changes: same base and method; also learns principles and nearby pages, with longer texts (8,192 tokens)
